name: financial-forecasting-platform
description: End-to-end budgeting, forecasting, pricing, risk and expenditure-reporting platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ffp/shared && npm run build --workspace @ffp/engine && npm run build --workspace @ffp/api && npm run build --workspace @ffp/web
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @ffp/shared && npm run build --workspace @ffp/engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @ffp/api" "npm run dev --workspace @ffp/web"
scripts._comment_e2e: Runner rather than a ';'-chained command: npm uses cmd.exe on Windows, where ';' is not a separator, so the chain silently ran nothing. The runner also aggregates exit codes; the chain reported only the last suite's.
scripts.test:ui:all: node scripts/run-e2e.mjs ui-journey ui-pricing ui-operations ui-a11y
scripts._comment_db: Prisma runs from the repo root so it picks up the single .env; the schema is passed explicitly.
scripts._comment_reset: Resetting under a running API invalidates its pooled prepared statements: writes 500, and a write that does succeed can be stored mis-encoded, which permanently breaks the audit chain. db:reset:stack restarts the API so that window cannot open.
scripts.db:reset:stack: npm run db:reset && docker compose restart api
scripts._comment_startmenu: Per-user Start Menu shortcuts for demonstrations. No elevation, nothing written outside the user profile; uninstalling deletes a folder.
scripts._comment_verify: build:libs runs before typecheck because api typechecks against shared/dist/*.d.ts, not the sources. Without it, tsc blames the consumer for a field the source plainly declares.
scripts.verify: npm run check:invariants && npm run check:reachability && npm run check:tables && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:coverage:api
